cs.t: i too have noticed this and as such, have switched to USB out to async USB input DAC that supports that. there are plenty of good quality, low cost DACs available from folks like schiit, smsl, topping, etc. (cheap enough that as someone that used to 'roll tubes' in my audio systems, i can now 'roll DACs' instead lolol). i'm quite partial to the ESS sabre series of DACs at this point personally.

cs.t: I'm a fan of SMSL products  https://www.smsl-audio.com/  My desk setup is their AD-18 driving L/R bookshelf speakers and a compact subwoofer via its dedicated sub output.
